stem: A meter remains unstable after the permitted cleaning and verification steps. What is the strongest response?
choices: Keep measuring until a preferred number appears
Document the suspect instrument status and escalate rather than using an unreliable value as verified data
Adjust the crop based on the unstable reading
rationale: Document the suspect instrument status and escalate rather than using an unreliable value as verified data. This preserves the Course 004 measurement, root-zone, nutrition, work-order, equipment or record-quality principle being assessed.
